notes: All samples are paraquat-tolerance ALE isolates; the unevolved parent GLU4 (0_0) is not in this series, so no reference-genotype control and is_control is left out. Mutations are only on aledb, so perturbed_genes and global_regulator_perturbed are left out. Paraquat for 20 min added at OD 0.5 in M9 glucose (mid_exponential inferred, acute).

base_medium.q: Strains were grown overnight in M9 minimal media with 0.4% w/v glucose as a carbon source

medium_class.q: M9 minimal media with 0.4% w/v glucose as a carbon source

amino_acids_supplied.q: M9 minimal media with 0.4% w/v glucose as a carbon source

carbon_source.q: M9 minimal media with 0.4% w/v glucose as a carbon source

growth_phase.q: Cultures were aerated with a stir bar at 1100 rpm in a water bath maintained at 37°C until OD reached 0.5

culture_mode.q: Cultures were aerated with a stir bar at 1100 rpm

oxygen.q: Cultures were aerated with a stir bar at 1100 rpm

growth_temperature.q: in a water bath maintained at 37°C

genotype_class.q: We then evolved it with increasing PQ concentrations over 33 days in triplicate

strain_group.q: a strain of E. coli MG1655 which was media-adapted using ALE

strain_name.q: We started with GLU4 (0_0), a strain of E. coli MG1655 which was media-adapted using ALE
